title: KID ROWS PICKED UP AT LAUNCH
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the kid rows (Kid damage, Kid firing, Player 2 comes back after death) are shared between the two windows, but a window only pulled them when the other window changed them while it was open, or when its own Settings opened. A window launched after the other one changed them played the old values until Settings was opened. Proven in headless Chromium: the boot path never reads the shared rows; with own Kid damage 1/2, Kid firing on and comes back on, and a newer share with all off, the old values stayed. The shared rows are now read once at launch, right after the save is read; an older share still leaves his own values alone.
now: A window opened later now starts with the kid rows the other window set.

edits.replacement:
PLOADED=true;
  try{ kidSync(); }catch(_kb){}   // v16.xx (cloud-menus-kid-sync-launch), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the kid rows the other window set were pulled only on its storage event and when Settings opened, so a window launched later played stale Kid damage, Kid firing and comes back after death; pulled once here at launch (not in loadProfile, which Restore backup also runs)
